hooks: You have an opening. Now, how do you answer 'tell me about a time when...'?
Your stories need real experience. What do you say when you have only a little?
You can answer honestly. What do you ask them at the end?
Good answers can still be undone. Which small habits make interviewers say no?
behavioral.upNext: Next, take it to a mock interview: practise these answers out loud and against a timer.
